scope: POSIX durable member-add correlation module, tested against the published native daemon with private terminal seats and separate client processes. Not activated in the WebMux creation path.
limits: No owner launch-plan resolution, manager identity authorization or production create/UI integration in this module. The caller must establish these before dispatch.
Journal keys are caller-supplied logical-request identities, not browser-provided authorization. Manager identity and exact route/body are immutable per key.
Explicit inspection uses the same correlated POST. If the first POST never reached the daemon, inspection can be its first execution. It cannot invent a replacement UUID or a different request.
Native receipts correlate enrollment IDs, not process readiness, current liveness or authenticated coding.
Native tests use terminal seats, not authenticated provider sessions or reboot. Native manager restart and separate client process checks are included.
POSIX-only journal; Windows refuses before creating a journal. Normal review/CI/audit/release gates remain open.
